message: Mirrored in Y about Y-3.75: 4 words and 2 codes on 4 blocks (G2 and G3, G41 and G42 swapped). No machine chosen: a word whose reading depends on the machine would refuse the run.

findings.message: Mirroring reverses the cutting direction: climb milling is now conventional milling, and the other way round. Check the cutting data.
